stem: Cross-pollination of flowers from different populations of the same species will most likely result in —

options.label: A
options.text: gene flow as new alleles are introduced

options.label: B
options.text: evolution of a different species as alleles mix

options.label: C
options.text: hybrid sterility as gametes from different individuals are incompatible

options.label: D
options.text: a decrease of genetic variation among individuals

visual_elements: Text with question number 43 and multiple choice answers labeled A through D.
